items:
CHECK FLUID CONDITION
If the ATF smells burnt or is black, replace it.

items:
DEPRESS ACCELERATOR PEDAL ALL THE WAY AND CHECK THAT THROTTLE VALVE OPENS FULLY
If the throttle valve does not open fully, adjust the accelerator link.

ADJUST THROTTLE CABLE
(a) Adjust the cable housing so that the distance between the end of the boot and the stopper on the cable is correct.
Distance: 0 — 1 mm (0 — 0.04 in.)
(b) Tighten the adjusting nuts.
(c) Recheck the adjustments.

content.description: Throttle cable adjustment showing inner cable, rubber boot (straight type), cable stopper, outer adjusting nuts cable, and measurement of 0-1mm between boot and stopper. Includes note 'WHEN THROTTLE VALVE IS FULLY OPENED'
labels: WHEN THROTTLE VALVE IS FULLY OPENED

items: (a) Loosen the nut on the shift linkage.
(b) Push the manual lever fully rearward.
(c) Return the lever two notches to the NEUTRAL position.
(e) While holding the selector lightly toward the "R" range side, tighten the shift linkage nut.

content.text: If the engine will start with the shift selector in any range other than "N" or "P", adjustment is required.

items: LOOSEN NEUTRAL START SWITCH BOLT AND SET SHIFT SELECTOR IN "N" RANGE

ADJUST NEUTRAL START SWITCH
(a) Disconnect the neutral start switch connector.
(b) Connect the ohmmeter between the terminals.
(c) Adjust the switch to the point where there is continuity between N and B terminals.
(d) Connect the neutral start switch connector.

TORQUE NEUTRAL START SWITCH BOLT
Torque: 55 kg·cm (48 in.·lb, 5.4 N·m)
